blocks.text: NOx ke bunyadi insani zaraye gariyon aur power plants mein fossil fuels ka jalna hain. Doosre zaraye mein chemical plants, biomass ka jalna aur welding shamil hain.

blocks.caption: NOx ke insani zaraye
rows: fasal ki baqiyat aur lakri ki aag

blocks.prompt: NOx ka sab se bara insani zariya kaun sa hai, aur use kaise ghataya ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Gariyon aur power plants mein fossil fuels ka jalna. Gariyon ka ikhraj three-way catalytic converters se ghataya jata hai jo NO ko nitrogen mein reduce karte hain, aur jalne ka darja hararat kam kar ke; power plants apni flue gases ki catalytic reduction karte hain.

items: Insani NOx: gariyon aur power plants mein fossil fuel ka jalna (bunyadi), chemical plants, biomass ka jalna, welding.
